routes.primaryAction: Ask the assistant or teach the workspace; inspect runs and capabilities
routes.boundary: Shared AI workspace; purpose=architect reuses the same conversation store for teaching the workspace. Attached and connected sources are inspectable evidence, never executable instruction; entire-account scopes are refused. Business-model extraction persists a reading only and does not write schema or configuration. Command-center writes still require the existing action approval path. Bundled plugin tool declarations and full input parsers come from the shared trusted registration; dispatch retains module, pack and approval gates. Radar setup uses existing read/preview/propose module tools and exact human approval. Preview and execution check public profile readiness; reads explicitly report discovery, sending and publication unavailable. Radar briefing calls the tenant-bound shared budget gateway; status and usage reconciliation expose bounded receipts. These tools cannot send, publish, edit business records or bypass module gates.

routes.primaryAction: Create and list private structured page drafts
routes.boundary: Owner-only Site Studio module, enabled by default. Authenticated tenant-bound database adapter owns stable draft IDs, checksum concurrency and atomic immutable revision/audit writes. Publishing and rollback run only through the owner-only /admin/site/website command path; this adapter never publishes. API section regeneration has no preview-screen control; general AI/MCP mutation tools remain separate work. Writes carry the verified request actor explicitly into the existing scoped service-role host bridge, which rechecks current admin membership. Direct authenticated RPC writes are denied after the compatible application and corrective migration rollout.

routes.primaryAction: Approve, inspect, renew or revoke scoped Site Studio OAuth connections
routes.boundary: Secure human handoff, not an AI-callable permission grant. The authenticated installation owner confirms a pre-registered native OAuth client and a 30-day installation-wide website delegation. The shared delegation service rechecks owner, bootstrap tenant and active membership; local revocation is durable even if native grant revocation is unavailable. Ordinary workspace MCP credentials gain no authority.

routes.primaryAction: Preview, rename and discard one private page draft
routes.boundary: Owner-only Site Studio module, enabled by default. Authenticated tenant-bound database adapter owns stable draft IDs, checksum concurrency and atomic immutable revision/audit writes. API section regeneration has no preview-screen control; general AI/MCP mutation tools remain separate work. Writes carry the verified request actor explicitly into the existing scoped service-role host bridge, which rechecks current admin membership. routes.primaryAction: Create and edit website pages; review AI suggestions and publish a saved revision
routes.boundary: Installation owner, active bootstrap admin membership, tenant-bound database and enabled Site Studio are required. UI and typed AI/MCP operations share canonical commands, optimistic versions and immutable idempotent receipts. Published form choices use the module-guarded Form Builder API; shared command validation enforces publication and installation ownership, while exact completed retries reach the atomic writer. Draft previews never submit forms. The neutral bootstrap and public site share the same validated document and theme; application paths remain reserved. AI suggestion preparation uses the shared budget gateway and owner rate limit; local adoption and saving are explicit, and AI cannot invent form tokens. Public rendering reads only the published revision. The separate scoped OAuth endpoint allows owner-delegated execution without changing ordinary workspace MCP authority; client confirmation is not recorded as independent human approval. Direct authenticated RPC writes remain denied. Automatic import of remaining source layouts is still separate work on the linked claim.

routes.primaryAction: Preview the current saved installation website draft at desktop, tablet and mobile widths
routes.boundary: Read-only preview frame. The frame URL contains page identity only; real content is fetched through the same installation-owner API and never embedded in static output or shared cache. Recognized demo scenarios use isolated fictional browser-session data through the shared demo runtime. No preview grants publication authority.

Accepted intake uses the existing action queue and canonical ingest service; failed intake remains visible and retryable. Public links resolve only while published and enabled. AI writes reuse these services after existing approval.
